topic: Closing of Books & Transfer of Assets to Realisation
question: Pass Journal Entries on dissolution: (a) Sundry Debtors ₹80,000 and Provision for Doubtful Debts ₹6,000 transferred to Realisation. (b) Machinery of book value ₹60,000 sold for ₹52,000 in cash. (c) Unrecorded investment of ₹10,000 taken by partner A at ₹8,500.
solution_steps: 1. Gross debtors are transferred to Realisation Dr. and provision to Realisation Cr.
2. Cash received from sale of machinery credited to Realisation A/c.
3. Asset taken over by partner debited to Partner Capital A/c at agreed value (₹8,500).
working_notes: Provision for Doubtful Debts is never netted off against Debtors when transferring to Realisation A/c.

journal_entries.particulars:
Realisation A/c .............................................................. Dr.
Provision for Doubtful Debts A/c ................................. Dr.
    To Sundry Debtors A/c

Bank A/c .......................................................................... Dr.
    To Realisation A/c
(Being machinery realized in cash)

A's Capital A/c ................................................................ Dr.
    To Realisation A/c
(Being unrecorded investment taken by A)

topic: Settlement of Creditors, Partner Loan & Expenses (Board Standard)
question: Pass necessary Journal Entries on dissolution of P & Q: (i) Unrecorded asset of ₹25,000 realized ₹20,000. (ii) Stock of book value ₹30,000 taken by P at ₹26,000. (iii) Creditors of ₹50,000 accepted machinery of book value ₹60,000 at ₹45,000 in partial satisfaction; balance paid by cheque. (iv) Q loan of ₹40,000 settled for ₹38,000. (v) Dissolution expenses ₹5,000 paid by P, for which he gets fixed remuneration of ₹7,000. (vi) Realisation loss ₹18,000 divided in 2:1.
solution_steps: 1. Cash from unrecorded asset debited to Bank and credited to Realisation.
2. Stock taken over by P debited to P Capital A/c at agreed value ₹26,000.
3. Creditors accepting asset requires entry only for the balance cash payment (₹50,000 − ₹45,000 = ₹5,000).
4. Q Loan settled: Q Loan Dr ₹40,000, Bank Cr ₹38,000, Realisation Cr ₹2,000 (discount gain).
5. Firm bears only agreed remuneration of ₹7,000 to P. P personal expense payment (₹5,000) is ignored.
6. Realisation loss apportioned in 2:1: P = ₹12,000, Q = ₹6,000.
working_notes: CBSE Rule: No entry is passed when a creditor accepts an asset in partial or full settlement.

journal_entries.particulars:
Bank A/c .......................................................................... Dr.
    To Realisation A/c
(Being unrecorded asset realized in cash)

P's Capital A/c ................................................................ Dr.
    To Realisation A/c
(Being stock taken over by partner P)

Realisation A/c .............................................................. Dr.
    To Bank A/c
(Being balance cash paid to creditors)

Q's Loan A/c .................................................................... Dr.
    To Bank A/c
    To Realisation A/c
(Being loan settled and discount transferred)

Realisation A/c .............................................................. Dr.
    To P's Capital A/c
(Being dissolution remuneration allowed to P)
